cleanDraft: Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus is a novel by Mary Shelley, first published anonymously in London in 1818, with a revised edition following in 1831. Frankenstein, a Genevan student of natural philosophy, recounts how he assembled and animated a creature from dead matter.
